purpose: Ten distinct deep-space panoramas, one for each world

images.name: aurora
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-quality background texture for an existing 3D space game, panorama for planet aurora. Primary request: a gorgeous cinematic deep-space background, unique to this planet. Scene: lavender-blue cosmic aurora, cyan luminous dust ribbons and indigo interstellar space; delicate pearl star clusters. Style: naturalistic astronomical photography with polished cinematic depth and exquisite delicate nebula detail, convincing fine stellar dust, stars of varied but mostly small size, rich dark negative space. Composition: one complete 360-degree equirectangular panorama, landscape aspect ratio 2:1, ideally 2048x1024. Distribute subtle beauty across the panorama so it remains interesting in any viewing direction, keep the equatorial viewing zone fairly dark and uncluttered for a separately rendered foreground spaceship and planet. Matching left and right edges, avoid a harsh seam. Constraints: background only; no foreground planets, no spaceships, no humans, no UI, no text, no logos, no watermark, no flat gradient placeholder, no large glaring lens flares. Deliver ONE finished full-frame image, not a collage or contact sheet.
